name: Software Development
description: A product engineering board from backlog to done. Each swimlane is a squad; each card is a story, bug, or chore.

swimlanes.name: Web App
swimlanes.notes: Browser client: boards, cards, and everything users click. Owns the component library.

swimlanes.name: Mobile
swimlanes.notes: iOS and Android apps. Ships on the two-week store release train.

swimlanes.name: API
swimlanes.notes: Public REST API, background jobs, and the data model behind them.

swimlanes.name: Platform
swimlanes.notes: Shared services, SDKs, and internal tooling other squads build on.

swimlanes.name: Infrastructure
swimlanes.notes: CI/CD, hosting, observability, and on-call tooling.

swimlanes.name: Quality
swimlanes.notes: Test automation, release verification, and flaky-test triage.

swimlanes.name: Security
swimlanes.notes: Application security, dependency hygiene, and compliance evidence.

swimlanes.name: Developer Docs
swimlanes.notes: API reference, guides, and release notes.
